description: Simulatore ordini e promozioni per confrontare fatturato lordo, margine totale e margine percentuale su scenari commerciali predefiniti.

userStories.title: Add simulation calculation engine
userStories.description: As a user, I want simulation totals calculated consistently so that I can trust revenue and margin comparisons.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a pure simulation module under src/lib
Move all tests, including existing tests, into a tests folder
Support gross revenue, net revenue, payout, supplier cost, margin amount, and margin percent
Add scenario discounts to product DB discounts and cap effective discount at 100 percent
Calculate payout only on the gross amount paid by the customer
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add random order generator
userStories.description: As a user, I want realistic random orders so that promotion simulations approximate buyer behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Generate at least 1000 generic orders with 1-8 product lines and quantity 1-4 per line
Generate 3x2 orders with exactly 3 or 6 product units
Generate 4x3 orders with exactly 4 or 8 product units
When simulating multiple options, reuse the same product count and the same products across every option so results can be compared like-for-like
Use deterministic seed support for repeatable tests
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add promotion scenario rules
userStories.description: As a user, I want each promotion scenario to follow the intended commercial rules so that I can compare campaigns correctly.
acceptanceCriteria: Add scenarios: DB/base, 10 percent, 20 percent, 25 percent, 30 percent, 3x2, 4x3, 3x2 no KIT, 4x3 no KIT
In 3x2 and 4x3, each unit counts separately and the cheapest eligible unit is free for every complete group
In no-KIT scenarios, category KIT is matched case-insensitively, excluded from bundle counting, and discounted by DB discount plus 20 percent
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Build simulation options panel
userStories.description: As a user, I want a simulation panel on the main page so that I can activate scenarios and read totals without leaving the product workflow.
acceptanceCriteria: Add the simulation section between settings and products
Show all scenarios selected by default
Allow activating and deactivating each scenario with checkboxes
Add a button to rerun the random simulation
Show an empty state when there are no saved products
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using Codex browser or in-app browser

userStories.title: Display aggregated simulation results
userStories.description: As a user, I want clear aggregated results for every selected scenario so that I can compare campaign profitability quickly.
acceptanceCriteria: Show scenario name, order count, product count, gross revenue, margin amount, and margin percent
Format currency as EUR and percentages with Italian formatting
Visually distinguish negative, low, and healthy margins
Keep the layout usable on desktop and mobile
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using Codex browser or in-app browser

userStories.title: Document order simulations
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the README to describe simulations so that future users understand the feature and its assumptions.
acceptanceCriteria: Update Italian README feature list and usage notes
Update English README feature list and usage notes
Document that 3x2 simulations use 3 or 6 products and 4x3 simulations use 4 or 8 products
Typecheck passes
